title: CaseMemberScope

member_id.description: The workspace member (role member, never owner) this case scope is given to.

sources.description: Visible case sources; ["*"] means all. Empty only on a revoked scope.

tenants.description: Visible tenants (tenant_ref values); ["*"] means all, including cases without a tenant. Empty only on a revoked scope.

numbers.description: Case numbers the member works on (an external collaborator). Empty means no narrowing: the source and tenant match alone decides. When not empty, only these numbers that also match sources and tenants are visible.

updated_by.description: The workspace owner who last granted, changed or revoked this scope.

description: What one workspace member may see of the received cases, used only while [member_access] enabled = true in the case settings. The same source and tenant rule as a sending app scope applies, optionally narrowed to explicit case numbers. Cases outside the scope are indistinguishable from absent ones (404). A revoked scope is kept with role null and empty lists so its revision never goes back; it grants nothing.

role.title: CaseMemberRole
role.description: viewer reads only. editor also adds replies, links and people and changes status, approval and deadlines. null is the retained, revoked scope.

source_or_all.title: CaseScopeSource
source_or_all.description: A case source prefix, or * (only as the single item) for all sources.
